units.source_text: 众多鬼卒在殿前候着，看着杜子春，立马上来将他困住，按倒在高阶前面。

en.t: Many demon guards were waiting in front of the hall. When they saw Toshishun, they immediately came forward, bound him, and forced him down before the high steps.

units.source_text: 高阶上有一位威严肃穆的大王，那人身着黑袍，头戴金冠，正睥睨众人，这人想必就是以前常听人说的阎罗王。

en.t: On the high steps stood a solemn and majestic king. He wore a black robe and a golden crown, and was looking down on everyone with contempt. This had to be King Yama, whom Toshishun had so often heard people speak of before.

units.source_text: 杜子春提心吊胆的跪在地上，不知道还要经历什么遭遇。

en.t: Toshishun knelt on the ground in terror, not knowing what he would have to go through next.
